_about: Public-domain John Bailey Adger (1810-1899), Southern Presbyterian missionary to Smyrna and Columbia Seminary professor, for the Word Hoard: The Religious Instruction of the Colored Population (1847), Christian Missions and African Colonization (1857) and My Life and Times, 1810-1899 (1899), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 55 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

adger-religious-instruction: The religious instruction of the colored population. A sermon (Charleston, T. W. Haynes, 1847)
adger-life-and-times: My life and times, 1810-1899 (Richmond, Va. : The Presbyterian Committee of Publication, 1899)

_excluded.adger-other: The Collected Writings of J. H. Thornwell he co-edited (on the thornwell shelf); uploaded transcriptions of his Southern Presbyterian Review articles, which have no scan

_identity_checked.adger-african-colonization: Title page OCR reads 'Christian Missions and African Colonization. BY JOHN B. ADOEK' (Adger garbled), Columbia: E. H. Britton 1857; a review of J. Leighton Wilson's Western Africa.

adger-religious-instruction.ia_possible_copyright_status: The Library of Congress is unaware of any copyright restrictions for this item.
